pavakkhati.cp: fut. of pavadati. he will tell.
pavakkhati.p: [ pa + vaca + a + ssati. ] (kri) (pravakyati.saṃ) Google Translate will speak.

H: pavakkhati：[pa-vac 的 fut．] 將會說，（是）會說的吧．1sg．pavakkhāmi （I will declare or explain）．
S: pavakkhati：[pa-vac の fut．] 説くであろう，言うであろう．1sg．pavakkhāmi．
D: Pavakkhati，（pavadati 的【未】），他将会看得出。（p217）
F: Pavakkhati，（pavadati 的【未】），他将会看得出。
P: Pavakkhati，[fut．of pa+vac] only in 1st sq．pavakkhāmi “I will declare or explain” Sn．701，963=1050 （cp．Nd1 482 & Nd2 under brūmi）．（Page 442）
U: PAVAKKHATI：（thì vị lai của pavadati） nó sẽ nói （thuật lại）
DOP: 1 pavakkhati fut. 3 sg. [ of pa 5 + vacati; cf S. pravakti, vakṣyati], will declare, will expound, will tell; Vin I 99, 3* (uddānaṃ anupubbaso ~āmi); D III 272, 9* (dasuttaraṃ ~āmi dhammaṃ nibbānapattiyā; Sv 1054, 32 : ~āmī ti kathessāmi); Sn 963 (taṃ te ~āmi yathā pajānaṃ; Nidd I 482, 7 : vakkhāmi ~āmi ācikkhissāmi desissāmi … pakāsissāmi); Ja V 324, 6* (Nandassāpi nisāmetha vacanaṃ yaṃ ~ati); VI 532, 5* (so te maggaṃ ~ati); Ap 47, 8 (atthaṃ tuyhaṃ ~āmi); Mhv 1:1 (mahāvaṃsaṃ ~āmi); — see also pavatta(r).

pāvaka.p: [ pu(pū) + ṇvu, punātīti pāvako. Dhāna, ṭī. 33. Kaccaññaḥ. 641. ] (pu) Google Translate (1)(a) fire; (Forest fire, bonfire, flame.) (b) Coal, Fireworks. (2) What kind of bird is it? Flying salamander. (Pali English Dictionary, U Yeu Sein, Dhan also has (ti) pure, bright, clean.

P: Pāvaka，（adj．n．） [fr．pu，Vedic pāvaka] 1．（adj．） pure，bright，clear，shining J．V，419．-- 2．（m．） the fire S．I，69； A．IV，97； Dh．71，140； J．IV，26； V，63 （=kaṇha-vattanin） VI，236 （=aggi C．）； Pv．I，85； Vism．170 （=aggi）．（Page 455）

pāvaka：ပါဝက （တိ）

pāvaka：ပါဝက （ပ） （√ပူ+ဏွု）
မီး။
DOP: pāvaka pāvaga mfn. and m. [ S. pāvaka], 1. ( mfn. ) pure, bright; Ja V 419, 29´ (sucigandhena ca manuññena ca hadayabandhanasamatthatāya ~ena ca padesena samannāgate ti attho, Ce, Ee so; Be māvakena; Se manāpakena; cf W.B. Bollée, 1970, p. 126: ‘pāvaka flowers’ ); — 2. ( m. ) fire; Abh 33; Vin I 25, 26* (makkhaṃ ca asahamāno ahināgo ~o va pajjāli); S I 69, 22* (pahūtabhakkaṃ jālinaṃ ~aṃ kaṇhavattaniṃ daharo ti nāvajāneyya; Spk I 133, 28 : ~an ti aggiṃ, pāvagan ti pi pāṭho); Dhp 140 (agārāni aggī ḍahati ~o); Vv 83:8 (ādittaṃ vata maṃ santaṃ ghatasittaṃ va ~aṃ vārinā viya osiñcaṃ) = Pv 8:5; Ja IV 26, 16* (kaṭṭhasmiṃ matthamānasmiṃ ~o nāma jāyati); VI 236, 33 (taṃ kammaṃ nihitaṃ aṭṭhā bhasmacchannova ~o); Vism 171, 26 (~o kaṇhavattanī jātavedo hutāsano ti ādisu aggināmesu); Cp-a 233, 25 (attano patiṭṭhānassa asuddhassāpi suddhabhāvakaraṇena pāvanato ~o ti); Sadd 334, 7* (aggi … tejo ~o …); 865, 20 (punātī ti ~o); 922, 16 (~o pāvago … vaṇṇabhedo ’yaṃ); — ifc see joti-.
